scope: Repository/tooling preparation for the seven-wave Technician I/II certification validation campaign. This registry does not convert preparation into human, pilot, deployment or governance evidence.

waves.name: Occupational / technical validation
waves.nextExecution: Recruit representative current cannabis cultivation SMEs/employers, collect independent ratings, reconcile tasks/role boundaries, record exact-version occupational approval evidence.

waves.name: Exact-version assessment review
waves.nextExecution: Complete exact-version human assessment review records for applicable assessment definitions/items using the strengthened construct, key, fairness, accessibility and security criteria.

waves.name: Rendered accessibility / learner UX
waves.nextExecution: Run manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, mobile/tablet/desktop and assessment-interaction review against exact deployed builds; remediate and retest.

waves.name: Practical / capstone assessor calibration
waves.nextExecution: Have paired assessors independently score common samples, aggregate inter-rater evidence, resolve critical-failure disagreements, revise/version rubrics when needed.

waves.name: Controlled pilot + item analysis
waves.nextExecution: Recruit representative pilot participants, collect private exact-version response/performance data, aggregate de-identified evidence, disposition findings and re-pilot meaningful revisions.

waves.name: Formal standard setting
waves.nextExecution: After review/pilot/calibration prerequisites, run panel standard-setting studies and separately record governance adoption of exact-version decision rules.

waves.name: Secure forms + credential authorization + production evidence
waves.nextExecution: Build/validate private operational forms, execute privacy/legal review for candidate governance 0.2.0, deploy/validate all production controls, then reconcile and approve exact-version Technician I/II credential authorization.

truthRules: prepared means repository structures, protocols, exact-version anchors, forms or scripts are ready for real execution
evidence-complete requires actual human, learner, assessor, panel, facility or deployment evidence as applicable
approved requires the designated authority to approve the exact current evidence/version
owner approval of source-backed academic content does not manufacture pilot, inter-rater, accessibility, standard-setting, privacy/legal, security or deployment evidence
